newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Light still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Light still a buy.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch & Co said it has reiterated its buy recommendation on shares of Brazilian power firm Light, which was privatized last year.
-- "Light enjoys a superior sales mix and a strong balance sheet," the brokerage said in a report.
-- Light's concession contract is "highly attractive," mainly regarding rates, and its privatization has improved efficiency, it said.
-- The main points of concern on the company are the strong competition it is likely to face and the lack of disclosure concerning its business plan and dividend policy, Merrill Lynch said.
-- Light common was off 0.85 percent at 349 reais at 1551 local time/1851 EST on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
